explication: SQLx is an asynchronous Rust SQL toolkit. In the main workflow, an application builds a query, binds Rust values, executes it through an executor and database driver, then consumes decoded rows. The repository also provides compile-time query checking and derives, connection pooling, runtime-selectable `Any`, migrations and PostgreSQL notifications. Driver internals and some CLI relationships are represented at subsystem level where the supplied excerpts do not establish finer-grained calls; those links are omitted or marked unverified.
